methods.dormant_failure: Every failing stock is dormant, while temperature passes its original 0.01 K bound. Stock/cell fractions and 21 sampled current-platform source balances explain scale without diagnosing noise from smallness.
methods.envelopes: Four 20,000-year windows with 10-year observations. Peak periods use sampled times and optional three-point parabolic interpolation; these are finite-resolution estimates.
methods.no_new_labels: Native summaries and physical/census rules remain unchanged. Source-free predictions are counterfactual diagnostics unless every sampled retained incoming source is absent; no between-sample absence proof is claimed.
methods.persistent_candidate: At least 3 peaks per window, temperature range >= 0.01 K and all four ranges within 20%. This is a triage heuristic, not a stationarity or periodic-orbit test.
